en: A black and white vintage postcard showing a rugged, hilly landscape with visible remnants of mining structures at the bottom of a valley, next to a river. The surroundings are natural, with rocky outcrops and sparse vegetation. At the top, there is printed text in French identifying the location as the old lead and silver mines of Pranal and the Sioule, part of the Auvergne region's picturesque sites.
